name: Special City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 14, 2020 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that pursuant to Government Code Section 54956, by delivery of this written notice as provided by law, the Mayor has called a special meeting of the Lomita City Council. Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20. no physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. Access to the meeting will be available via URL: uberconference.com/lomitacity or by phone at 424-208-2491.
In order to effectively accommodate public participation, participants are asked to provide their public comments via e-mail before 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday, April 14, 2020, to ccpubliccomments@lomitacity.com. Please include the agenda item in the subject line. All Comments submitted will be read into the record until the time limit of five minutes has been reached.
All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
STUDY SESSION
3.
DISCUSSION REGARDING STATE OF CALIFORNIA PROJECT ROOMKEY IMPLEMENTATION AND POTENTIAL IMPACTS ON THE CITY OF LOMITA RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive oral report and provide direction to staff
4.
DISCUSSION REGARDING EMERGENCY PLANNING, PANDEMIC RESPONSE PLAN AND CONTINUITY OF OPERATIONS, AND CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2020-06
Presented by: City Manager, Ryan Smoot
RES NO. 2020-06 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, RATIFYING THE ACTIONS OF THE DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY SERVICES, EXTENDING THE CITY'S EMERGENCY MEASURES THROUGH MAY 15, 2020, AND TAKING RELATED ACTIONS
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Resolution No. 2020-06, provide direction to staff
Item #SS 4
5.
ADJOURNMENT I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: April 10, 2020
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
